name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.ngo
displayName: Signal Fish Room Coordinator for Netcode for GameObjects
description: Runs a Netcode for GameObjects session over a Signal Fish room: the room owns matchmaking and membership, the host allocates a Unity Relay server through a game hook and hands the join code to members over the room's game-data lane, and every NGO connection is approved against live room membership. Requires com.unity.netcode.gameobjects (detected by versionDefines or the included editor define detector), com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish, and com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.core.

samples.description: A host/client bootstrap that wires Unity Gaming Services Relay allocation into the coordinator and shows the scene steps for approval-driven joins.
